label: msg_ui_option_01_info
text: You can choose from different text-scrolling\nspeeds to control how quickly messages appear.

label: msg_ui_option_03_info
text: You can choose whether you wish to see move\nanimations during battles or not.

label: msg_ui_option_04_info
text: You can choose if you want to switch Pokémon\nafter an opponent faints or not.

label: msg_ui_option_05_info
text: You can choose to have Pokémon automatically\nsent to your Boxes or not when your party is full.

label: msg_option_10_01
text: Would you like to save these settings?

label: msg_ui_option_07_info
text: You can choose to have your game saved\nautomatically or not.

label: msg_ui_option_09_info
text: If you turn on this option, cutscenes that play\nduring game events will be skipped.

label: msg_ui_option_10_info
text: You can adjust the volume of background music.

label: msg_ui_option_11_info
text: You can adjust the volume of sound effects.

label: msg_ui_option_12_info
text: You can adjust the volume of Pokémon cries.

label: msg_ui_option_13_info
text: Would you like to reset the settings to\ntheir defaults?

label: msg_ui_option_select_01
text: Would you like to save these settings?

label: msg_ui_option_select_03
text: Would you like to reset all the settings to\ntheir defaults?

label: msg_ui_option_15_info
text: You can choose regular or inverted for vertical\ncamera controls.

label: msg_ui_option_16_info
text: You can choose regular or inverted for horizontal\ncamera controls.

label: msg_ui_option_17_info
text: You can select if you want to show your\nPokémon’s nicknames during Link Battles.

label: msg_ui_option_18_info
text: You can choose whether to be prompted to give\na nickname to a Pokémon when you obtain it.

label: msg_ui_option_skip_01
text:
Attention!\c
If you choose to skip cutscenes, some cutscenes
that are key to the story will also be skipped.\c
Please select this option only after you have
finished the main story once.\c
Are you sure you want to skip cutscenes?

label: msg_ui_option_19_info
text: You can choose not to be prompted to teach\nPokémon new moves as soon as they level up.

label: msg_ui_option_21_info
text: You can choose to enable or disable your\ncontroller’s rumble feature for this game.

label: msg_ui_option_22_info
text: You can choose whether helping functions will be\nactivated when you fall from a great height.

label: msg_ui_option_23_info
text: You can choose whether you want the camera to\ntrack you when using the Left Stick to move.

label: msg_ui_option_24_info
text: You can slow the interpolation speed when the\ncamera makes sudden, large movements.

label: msg_ui_option_25_info
text: You can choose how much distance you’d like\nbetween the camera and your character.

label: msg_ui_option_26_info
text: You can choose regular or inverted controls for\nascending or descending while [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]KoMiraidon is flying.
